text:
ashley: proposing a small "cost-handshake": edge stamps an opaque cost id on requests, runtime writes a short ledger entry (ttl 48h) with precise token counts so billing can join later. thoughts?

marta: +1 for survivable attribution. need join-window guarantees and tests for missing backfills.

devon: ledger write must be idempotent; batching 500-1000ms in runtime is ok to keep p95 low. include schema version in blob.

oliver: infra concerns: ~1k writes/s est. prefer Dynamo with hot cache and GC metrics; add alert for backfill success rate.

ashley: example header -> `X-Cost-Key: ck_abc123`; runtime PUT `/ledgers/ck_abc123` -> compact record {v:1,mid:123, tokens:120, q:"q4_0"}.

marta: store model_id not friendly name for compliance.

devon: also allow a tiny cost-only envelope retained even when full trace sampled out for quota-sensitive tenants.

infra-bot: estimate: 1.1k writes/s -> 95k/day. recommend batched writes and conditional puts.

ashley: rollout plan: flag edge emit only -> canary runtime writer -> enable pipeline join -> global flip. I'll open PR tomorrow.
